bio: Superbly situated alongside Hyde Park Corner and Wellington Arch, The Peninsula London occupies one of the city’s most prestigious addresses. Enjoy an elegant Afternoon Tea set amidst soaring ceilings, crystal chandeliers, hand-painted de Gournay murals and live music.  In the elegant space of The Lobby, the signature Afternoon Tea offers guests a luxurious experience within the grandeur of the hotel.  Indulge in a selection of savoury and sweet courses including Classic Scones with Dorset Clotted Cream, Coronation Chicken Croquettes, Smoked Lobster Sandwiches, and Potted Carrot Cake.  A celebrated tradition at Peninsula hotels around the globe, The Peninsula Signature Afternoon Tea is the ultimate indulgence. Afternoon Tea includes a glass of English Sparkling Wine or sparkling tea, or a gin and tonic. And of course, no Afternoon Tea would be complete without a cup of tea from the extensive tea menu, available throughout your experience.  Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or seeking a leisurely afternoon escape, The Peninsula London’s Afternoon Tea combines refined fare with impeccable service.
